 ORDER Heard on IA No 13911/2023 which is an application for taking documents on record.

3. sentences.text: 4. As per the prosecution story, prosecutrix and present applicant both known to each other since last four years and on the pretext of marriage the present applicant committed rape upon the applicants.
Accordingly, a case has been registered against the present applicant.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant contended that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this offence.
The prosecutrix is a major and matured lady.
She remained in the company of applicant for a period of four years, he also filed whatsapp chatting and other documents.
The applicant is permanent resident of Dewas District.

He placed reliance upon judgment of Hon'ble Apex court in the matter of Avtar Singh Vs. State of Punjab 2023 Cr.L.R. (SC)
512.

sentences.text: Under the above circumstances, prayer for grant of anticipatory bail may be considered on such terms and conditions, as this Court deems fit and proper.

6. Per-contra, learned counsel for the respondent - State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection.
7.
Counsel for objector also opposes the prayer by submitting that false pretext of marriage cannot be considered to be a consent of rape.
Hence applicant does not deserve for anticipatory bail.

8. Perused the impugned order of the trial Court as well as the case dairy.
9.
Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case and in view of the evidence available on record, this court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to applicant.
Hence this anticipatory bail application filed by applicant under section 438 Cr.P.C. is hereby rejected.
